name: softicon-store-locator
description: Store locator block for WordPress: a store list and an OpenStreetMap map, no Google Maps API key

scripts.zip:
rm -f softicon-store-locator.zip && printf '→ Building block
' && (npm run -s build >/dev/null 2>&1 || npm run build) && printf '→ Translations
' && (npm run -s i18n-pot >/dev/null 2>&1 || npm run i18n-pot) && npm run -s find-ds && printf '→ Zipping
' && cd .. && zip -rq softicon-store-locator/softicon-store-locator.zip softicon-store-locator/softicon-store-locator.php softicon-store-locator/index.php softicon-store-locator/includes softicon-store-locator/src softicon-store-locator/build softicon-store-locator/languages softicon-store-locator/readme.txt softicon-store-locator/package.json softicon-store-locator/webpack.config.js -x '*/.DS_Store' '*.map' 'softicon-store-locator/src/render.php'
scripts.postzip:
printf '
✔ Zip ready: %s
  %s files, %s

' "$PWD/softicon-store-locator.zip" "$(unzip -l softicon-store-locator.zip | tail -1 | awk '{print $2}')" "$(du -h softicon-store-locator.zip | cut -f1 | tr -d ' ')"
scripts.bundle: npm run lint && npm run zip
